index.name: Priority Places for Food Index
index.orientation: Decile 1 = highest priority (most vulnerable to food insecurity) within each nation.
index.measure: Share of the council's small areas in their nation's two highest-priority deciles (1-2). Small areas, not people: areas have broadly similar populations within each nation.
index.comparability: Deciles are set within each nation (about 20 % of a nation's areas are in deciles 1-2), so a council can be compared only with councils in the same nation. Rank councils within their nation; never across nations.
index.domainsWithoutDataNote: Not available in Northern Ireland: the Priority Places index has no data for this domain there (the publisher's user guide); Northern Ireland's combined index rests on four domains.
